name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Oil companies see soaring profits amid Iran war
changes.summary: As the threat of escalation in the war with Iran drives gas prices higher and hurts economies worldwide, one sector is doing really well, the revenue for Big Oil. Ali Bauman explains.

changes.title: Staff Sgt. Rampersad, 28, who always knew she wanted to serve, is laid to rest
changes.summary: Staff Sgt. Angel S. Rampersad is one of a handful of service members who've recently died in the conflict with Iran. Her family says she knew from a young age she wanted to serve in the military. (Image credit: Ryan Murphy).

changes.title: Evidence Indicates U.S. Dropped Bomb on Residential Area in Iran, Killing 3 Civilians
changes.summary: The weapon, one of the largest in the U.S.’s arsenal, struck a house in a heavily populated area, according to a Times analysis.

changes.title: Fact-Checking Trump’s Claims About the Effect of the Iran War on Oil Prices, Munitions and More
changes.summary: The president misleadingly blamed the Biden administration’s weapons transfers to Ukraine for current concerns over munitions stockpiles, among other claims about the Iran war.

changes.title: U.S., Israel preparing to bombard energy-related targets in Iran, sources say
changes.summary: The U.S. and Israel plan to hit Iran's energy infrastructure as soon as this weekend, although no final decision has been made, sources familiar with the matter told CBS News.

changes.title: Scope of Hacks on U.S. Water Supply Widens as Evidence Points to Iran
changes.summary: Michigan and Minnesota are among at least seven states coping with cyberattacks aimed at disrupting water systems nationwide.

changes.title: Iran Plotted Wider War With Help of Its Proxies
changes.summary: During a fleeting truce, Iranians covertly devised a plan to raise the war’s costs for President Trump if U.S. forces attacked anew.

changes.title: U.S. probes if Iran was behind cyberattack on utilities in Michigan, Minnesota
changes.summary: Malicious cyber activity affected technology at water systems in at least seven states this week, including Minnesota, leading authorities to dig into whether Iranian actors are behind the attack, CBS News has learned.

changes.title: State Department urges Americans to consider leaving Middle East as regional conflict escalates
changes.summary: The State Department on Saturday urged Americans across the Middle East to consider leaving the region or be prepared to depart on short notice, warning of flight disruptions and security risks as the conflict with Iran escalates.

changes.title: Trump threatens more strikes on Iran. Tensions from Hormuz to Kuwait and Gaza lead to more warnings
changes.summary: Here are the most important developments in the Middle East on Saturday.
